cards.scope: Complete the XLM parity and threat model
cards.evidenceText: Design decision: use one Stellar account per vault, funded and activated by the user's wallet through CreateAccount. Connected-wallet support remains to verify. XRC source can represent XLM/USD; its generic defaults include received-rate floor 3 and freshness up to 120 seconds, but live XLM source quorum and quote are unverified. The read-only IC connector refused the backend because its service-discoverability manifest is missing; the direct XRC sample is a paid update and was not called. Direct endpoint probes could not run under the local DNS sandbox. Mara Junior's first read-only audit and second Sonnet/Haiku design review are complete; open design, implementation, and release work remains. A 2-of-3 independent provider-result quorum is the Horizon target; provider selection remains unresolved and source helpers have no provider wiring. SDF public Horizon, Tatum authenticated Horizon, and Blockdaemon authenticated Horizon are research candidates; Ankr is a fourth candidate. None is validated or provisioned. Separately, a read-only mainnet XRP config check on 2026-10-27 returned Active, a $30,000 debt ceiling (3,000,000,000,000 e8s), and an explicit Linear rate curve. Decoded live values are a 128% borrow threshold, 117% liquidation ratio, 7.5% liquidation bonus, 0.2% borrowing fee, 1.5% base APR, and 132.266666666666666624% recovery target. Those differ from the XRP source constructor's $2,500 ceiling and 150%/133%/12% parameters; do not present constructor values as current live parity. XRP evidence only; no XLM registration, deployment, or live config is proved.

cards.scope: Build the Stellar rail and independent address and transaction vectors
cards.evidenceText: Commits 4d52680b and 7658ed2f add dormant pure credit/key state, multi-operation receipt parsing, and permanent custody attribution/status. The parser and state are source-only, uncompiled, and unrun; they do not establish live credit or settlement. Earlier provider fanout, freeze/pause, operation identity, signed bounds, and route guards likewise remain uncompiled/unrun. A provider network-binding agent is still working; there is no independent provider configuration or live call. Earlier focused `chains::stellar` Cargo tests passed 34/34 before these changes. No actual Horizon outcall or live deposit credit exists; pending claims/receipts remain dormant state, not a live lifecycle. No XLM registration, deployment, or collateral admission is proved.
